title: A warm coat
subtitle: Shopping with Rose — I wear or I'm wearing?
canDo: I can ask for clothes in a store.
I can say what I usually wear and what I'm wearing today.
teacherNotes: Present simple / continuous karşılaştırması bu dersin kalbi. Tahtaya iki sütun: usually, every day, on Mondays | now, today, Look! Öğrencilerden kendi örneklerini isteyin.
Türkler alışkanlık için de -iyor kullandığı için "I'm wearing jeans every day" hatası çok yaygın. Arapça konuşanlarda ise tersi sık: "Look! She wear…".
Rol oyunu: bir öğrenci satıcı (Can I help you? What size are you?), diğeri müşteri (I'm looking for… Can I try it on? How much is it?).
ABD'de pants = pantolon, İngiltere'de trousers. Derste jeans kullandık; sorarlarsa açıklayın.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: A cold Friday
sections.intro: The next morning at Harbor English School.
paragraphs: It's Friday morning, and it's very cold. Everyone is wearing warm clothes today.
Elif usually wears a T-shirt and jeans. Today she's wearing her new blue coat and a sweater.
Lucas usually wears a T-shirt too. Today he's wearing two sweaters, and he's still cold.
Omar is wearing a black coat, a hat and gloves.
Maya isn't wearing a coat in the classroom. She's wearing a red dress and a big scarf, and she's drinking hot tea.
And Sam? He's standing outside the café in a T-shirt.
“This isn't cold,” he says. “I'm from London!”

sections.title: Grammar: I wear or I'm wearing?
look: Today she**'s wearing** her new coat.
Elif **works** at the café on Saturdays. Today she**'s shopping** with Rose.

head: Present simple
Present continuous
rows: every day, usually, often, on Mondays

rules: Present simple: habits, things we do again and again. I **work** on weekends.
Present continuous: things happening **now** or **today**. I**'m working** now.
Some verbs don't usually take -ing: **like, love, want, need, know, understand**. I **need** a coat. (not I'm needing)
examples: I usually wear jeans, but today I'm wearing a dress.
Omar works at a hospital. Right now he's sleeping.
Do you wear a scarf in winter?

support.tr: İngilizcede iki şimdiki zaman var. Present simple (I wear) alışkanlıklar içindir: her gün, genellikle, pazartesileri. Türkçedeki geniş zamana benzer: Kot giyerim. Present continuous (I'm wearing) şu an ya da bugün için: Bugün mont giyiyorum. like, want, need, know gibi fiiller genelde -ing almaz: I need a coat.
support.ar: في الإنجليزية زمنان للحاضر. present simple (I wear) للعادات والأشياء المتكرّرة: كلّ يوم، عادةً، أيام الاثنين. present continuous (I'm wearing) لما يحدث الآن أو اليوم: I'm wearing a coat today = ألبس معطفًا اليوم. في العربية نقول «ألبس» في الحالتين، لذلك انظر إلى الكلمات: every day / usually ← simple، و now / today ← continuous. أفعال مثل like, want, need, know لا تأخذ ing عادةً: I need a coat.

tr.note: Türkçede alışkanlık için de -iyor kullanırız ("Her gün kot giyiyorum"), ama İngilizcede her gün / genellikle = present simple.

ar.note: كلمة usually أو every day ← present simple، وكلمة now أو Look! ← present continuous.
wrong: Look! She wear a new coat.
He is usually wearing a hat.
right: Look! She's wearing a new coat.
